title: File for free
subject: Money

text: Most working people do not need to pay a preparer.
Start at IRS.gov. A search ad that says free often is not.
If your 2025 adjusted gross income is $89,000 or less, guided software is free through IRS Free File.
You must start from the Free File page on IRS.gov. Opening a company's site directly can put you on a paid product.
VITA is free in-person help, generally for people who earned $69,000 or less, or who have a disability or limited English.
TCE is for people 60 and older. Both are IRS-certified volunteers. Find a site at IRS.gov/VITA.
The 2025 return is due April 15, 2026. An extension to October 15 is free to request, but any tax you owe is still due in April.
E-file and direct deposit is the fastest refund. Refunds with EITC or the Additional Child Tax Credit are not issued before mid-February.
Your AGI is $40,000. What is the free path?
